title: Module 2: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Master Classes, Inheritance, Interfaces, Polymorphism, and Enums.

lessons.title: Classes, Inheritance, Interfaces, and Enums

exercises.title: Interface vs Abstract Class
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Which of the following is true about interfaces in Java 21?
choices: They cannot have any method implementations.
A class can implement multiple interfaces.
They are instantiated using the `new` keyword directly.

exercises.title: Polymorphic Formatter
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Create a function `formatGreeting` that takes a `string` (name) and `boolean` (isFormal). If formal, return 'Good day, [name]'. Otherwise return 'Hi, [name]'.
hints: Use a simple `if/else` block or ternary operator.
String concatenation can be done with `+`.

exercises.title: Debug: Method Overriding
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Fix the child class so it correctly overrides the parent method and outputs 'Child print'.
hints: Check the method signature (name and parameters).
The method name must match exactly.
